tranches.name: Authority, Identity, Membership & Owner-Contract Closure
tranches.objective: Prove and close the canonical ownership graph from local identity proof through A3 invitation and A5 Campaign membership, including family safety, device-session lifecycle and local-host versus production-service authority composition.
acceptance: Every identity/session/invitation/membership/device authority has exactly one canonical owner and an explicit production/local-first adapter plan.
Select the zero-service local subject proof-of-possession model and recovery/rebind semantics without making device IDs authoritative.
Close A3 Invitation↔A5 Campaign-membership atomicity and membership-state transition/authentication-context contract holes.
Reconcile PCV-02 memberSubjectIds and product profile IDs as predecessor data that migrate/adapt into current owners rather than remain parallel authorities.
Map SMB-01 service-port semantics to a local-host profile while preserving the non-activated managed-production profile.
Disposition MIB-17/SMB-14 invitation/communication policy and BRP device-session/recovery requirements.
Publish field-level owner/dependency/consumer evidence; no generic 'audited' labels may substitute.

tranches.name: Data Model, Persistence, Transaction, Secret & Migration Closure
tranches.objective: Close the durable-state model before runtime implementation: relational logical schema, product JSON aggregates, transactions, membership/session state, secret references, migration/retirement and provider-exit/data-rights implications.
acceptance: Declare one durable truth model and exact adapter mapping between canonical logical owners and the installed SQLite product store.
Provide or specify atomic transaction/batch primitives required by invitation/membership/Session operations.
Reconcile Campaign membership state/version schema and classify device/resume/ACK/epoch/replay data as canonical, local-secret or ephemeral.
Select/wire an approved Windows+Android secure-secret-store boundary and safe backup/export/delete behavior.
Define migration/retirement for pre-audit PCV-03.session.1 and any PCV-01/02 predecessor fields that change ownership.
No raw bearer/local identity credential material is allowed in ordinary documents, diagnostics or telemetry.

tranches.name: Transport, Protocol, Capability & Security Contract Closure
tranches.objective: Freeze the safe zero-service transport/handshake contract before code: inference-safe signaling, peer binding, versioned/bounded envelopes, policy/timeouts, exact capability/entitlement negotiation and replaceable assisted networking.
acceptance: Define pre-auth and post-auth signaling fields, recipient binding and no-log sensitive token handling.
Define peer-to-authenticated-subject/device binding and transport revalidation without granting authority to SDP/device metadata.
Define explicit protocol/schema versioning, strict decoder behavior, message/batch/work bounds, backpressure and safe errors.
Resolve exact pack/rules/runtime/entitlement handshake sources from locally measured client state.
Keep manual/no-service ICE as baseline and assisted STUN/TURN/relay as replaceable optional adapters.
Record governed invitation/connection timeout policy and future Android local-network permission trigger.

tranches.name: Session Event, Recovery, Idempotency, Presence & Hybrid Continuity Closure
tranches.objective: Freeze command/Event/checkpoint/reconnect semantics so local-host, future hosted, live/async/hybrid and hidden projections share one durable history without duplicate effects or lost Events.
acceptance: Define command identity versus idempotency key versus payload fingerprint and host-authoritative timestamps.
Define serialized per-Session mutation/transaction ordering and transactional-outbox/advisory-realtime mapping.
Define global authoritative Event sequence, viewer projection cursor, ACK timing, gap detection and hidden-event behavior.
Define checkpoint digest/trust/replay fingerprint lifecycle and reconnect current-authorization requirements.
Define presence as connection-derived advisory state with no membership/identity authority.
Prove compatibility with SMB-02 and APW one-history live/async/hybrid expectations.

tranches.name: Product Context, Downstream Consumers, Mobile, Packaging & Evidence Closure
tranches.objective: Close the product/platform edges before implementation: A3-safe Home/context integration, downstream Session consumers, mobile/accessibility, package/update identity and a non-self-certifying physical evidence model.
acceptance: Reconcile ProductProfile/ProductSelectedContext with A3 authorized workspace/context/Home projections and cache partitions.
Classify MAS/APW/VTI/SAA/WCI/MSAS/IC/A6/A7/A9/SMB13/BRP consumers without implementing downstream domains.
Define phone/keyboard/nonvisual requirements for every PCV networking control while leaving full Desktop View to PCV-09.
Define exact package/install/update/migration identity and device-side evidence needed for Windows/Android certification.
Replace boolean/self-reported completion evidence with causal receipts that prove duplicate retry, real resume, player delivery and installed binary identity.
Disposition unrelated PR #775 presentation/skin changes to their correct owner/scope.

tranches.name: Final No-Orphan / No-Parallel-Owner Readiness Certification
tranches.objective: Perform a fresh adversarial sweep over the completed interstitial artifacts and current repositories; allow PCV-03A to start only when all required owner/dependency/consumer/validation bindings are explicit and no unresolved implementation prerequisite remains.
acceptance: Every gap register item is closed, explicitly routed to a bounded PCV-03 child, or explicitly deferred outside PCV with owner/rationale; no unowned/indeterminate blocker remains.
Zero silent duplicate owners, authority bypasses, unresolved required dependencies, missing required consumers, persistence/secret/migration unknowns or evidence blind spots remain for PCV-03 scope.
Current canon/wiring matrix is updated with field-level PCV evidence rather than generic audit labels.
Per-child PCV-03A..03F validation profiles/negative-regression ownership are defined before implementation.
Application packaging remains disabled until PCV-03F.
A final fresh repository search for identity/membership/Session/transport/recovery/device/security/packaging consumers yields no uncatalogued required PCV dependency.
Only then may CURRENT select PCV-03A and grant implementation authority.

completion_rule: PCV-PRE completes only when PCV-I06 certifies zero unowned/unresolved PCV-03 prerequisites and explicitly authorizes selection of PCV-03A. Completing archaeology alone or closing only the known candidate bugs is insufficient.
next_action: Execute PCV-I01 authority/identity/membership/owner-contract closure. PCV-03A and later PCV work remain blocked.
